name: ClickFix
description: Experimental ClickFix settings prototype for Geometry Dash Android.

enabled.name: Enable ClickFix
enabled.description: Master switch for ClickFix. The input correction engine is not implemented in this prototype.

input-buffer.name: Input Buffer
input-buffer.description: Prototype toggle; does not buffer gameplay inputs yet.

click-correction.name: Click Correction
click-correction.description: Prototype toggle; click timing correction is not implemented yet.

tolerance.name: Tolerance (ms)
tolerance.description: Planned correction window. Current prototype only saves this setting.

all-modes.name: All game modes
all-modes.description: Intended to support all modes. Not yet validated by gameplay hooks.
